[5:08PM] #Jibowu #Yaba #TrafficUpdate 

 Traffic flow from Adekunle intersection connecting to the Third Mainland Bridge, both inward and outward, is currently free. However, Makoko junction and Panti are experiencing significant congestion due to traffic intersection alterations. Approaching Sabo is also marked by heavy traffic resulting from the same traffic intersection issues. 

The stretch from St. Agnes towards Unilag junction, Yaba Tech, and WAEC is moving slowly due to ongoing road construction. Jibowu underneath the bridge is clear in both inward and outward directions. Heading from Jibowu towards Fadeyi is a steady flow of traffic. Traffic moving from Jibowu inward Yaba Phase 1 and 2 is very smooth. 

The entirety of Muritala Muhammed Way down to Adekunle is experiencing steady movement. Oyingbo inwards Iddo is clear, as is the alternate route via Ile Ile, with the return journey also reporting good flow. Kano Street inwards from Apena Cemetery down to Adekunle intersection is moving steadily. 

No traffic impediments beyond the mentioned traffic intersection alterations and construction have been reported, and officers are present to manage the situation.

#FollowLASTMA

[5:58PM] #CBD_Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

 Significant improvement is observed around the construction site on Adeniji Adele road, specifically near the Oba's Palace and Police post. However, inbound traffic moving from underneath the Idumota bridge towards Eyin Eyo, connecting Balogun and Martin streets, is currently experiencing slow movement due to ongoing market activities in the vicinity. 

Similarly, Tinubu Square, leading to Nnamdi Azikiwe street and towards the Tom Jones intersection, is experiencing heavy traffic due to the evening commute. In contrast, the Illubinrin route connecting Carter Bridge to Ijora and Oyingbo is currently flowing well. Overall, traffic impediments in the zone are reported to be minimal at this time, and officers remain on duty to ensure smooth traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:19PM] #IyanaIpaja #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic congestion is on both sides of the highway, specifically from Araromi to Iyana Ipaja underneath the bridge, due to the high volume of vehicular movement and the unregulated activities of commercial buses. However, our personnel are actively engaged in checkmating and controlling the situation.
Traffic is moving smoothly over the flyover bridge, particularly from Moshalasi Roundabout towards the Expressway and vice versa. LASTMA officers are strategically deployed to decongest the area and restore normalcy.
Our team is working diligently to evacuate a truck that broke down earlier in the morning at Alagba Roundabout.
Traffic movement is fluid on New Ipaja Road, both inward and outward, at Estate Gate and Baruwa.
The stretch leading to Egbeda Junction is experiencing smooth traffic flow.

LASTMA personnel are working assiduously to control traffic movement and ensure a smooth traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA
